attchmntText: Crompton Greaves Limited has informed the Exchange that a fire broke out at the Company's Transformer Office building in Kanjurmarg, Mumbai, late night on Saturday, July 30, 2016. The fire was confined to the Transformer Office building and was controlled with the quick arrival of the fire tenders. There were no casualties or injuries. The fire was restricted to the office area and the manufacturing facilities were not impacted. Customer deliveries will not be hampered as plant operations are as per schedule. An investigation into the cause of the fire and the extent of the damage is in progress. In the mean time, the contingency plans in line with Company's Business Continuity Management Processes are being activated to restore operational normalcy of the affected areas
sm_name: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited

attchmntText: Crompton Greaves Limited has informed the Exchange that in continuation to the previous communication letter dated July 13, 2016 on the subject captioned above, whereby the Company had informed the Stock Exchanges about the water logging inside the factory premises located at Mandideep that affected the Company's manufacturing facilities and also lead to temporary suspension of its operations, Company now hereby inform that post completion of the assessment carried out by the Insurer, the claims made by the Company towards the damages to the plant and machinery and also the loss of production has been accepted by the Insurer. Majority of the facilities are currently functional and the Management expects to restore normalcy in operations very shortly.
sm_name: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited

attchmntText: Crompton Greaves Limited has informed the Exchange that due to unprecedented torrential heavy rains, since July 9, 2016, the Company's manufacturing facilities located at Mandideep in Madhya Pradesh housing Transformers, Large Motors & Generator and Drives & Automation divisions, has been affected due to water logging inside the premises leading to temporary suspension of operations.The Company has activated its contingency plans in line with business continuity management processes intended to ensure that there is minimum disruption to maintain supplies to the customers. The Management is confident that normalcy in operations will be restored in a short time.
sm_name: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited

attchmntText: The Exchange had sought clarification from Crompton Greaves Limited with respect to an announcement dated February 19, 2015 captioned "Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on February 19, 2015, based on comments received from the SEBI, the Stock Exchanges and investors' feedback, has evaluated salient aspects of the Scheme of Arrangement with respect to demerger of the Consumer Products business of the Company. The Board has now reconsidered and approved the contours of the proposed demerger and decided to implement a 100% demerger of the Consumer Products business, such that the shareholding pattern of the Resulting Consumer Company shall mirror the shareholding pattern of CG. A scheme of arrangement incorporating the above principles will soon be considered by the Board of Directors". The Company vide email dated February 20, 2015 has clarified as below;  a) Brief details of the division to be demerged;   Ans :Consumer Products business of the Company   b) Turnover of the demerged division and as percentage to the total turnover of the Company in the immediately preceding financial year / based on financials of the last financial year;   Ans : 2847.05 crore (37.74%) as on March 31, 2014.  c) Rationale for demerger:  Ans : Rational behind the scheme of arrangement: Demerged Company is engaged in three distinct lines of business namely Power, Industrial and Consumer. The nature of risk and competition involved in each of the Power and Industrial Systems Business is distinct, given that they operate inter alia, in the business to business ("B2B") realm from that in the Consumer Products Business, which largely operates in the business to end consumer ("B2C") realm, necessitating different management approaches and focus. Thus, separation of the Consumer Products Business, by way of the Demerger Scheme, would lead to significant benefits for both B2B and B2C businesses.   d) Brief details of change in shareholding pattern (if any)of all entities:  Ans : The shareholding pattern of the Resulting Company will mirror the shareholding of CG.   e) In case of cash consideration   amount or otherwise share exchange ratio:  Ans : The scheme of demerger is yet to be placed for approval of the Board or Committee of Board for share entitlement ratio.   f) Whether listing would be sought for the resulting entity:  Ans : Yes. The listing will be made with BSE and NSE.
sm_name: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited

attchmntText: Crompton  Greaves Limited has informed the Exchange that " The Company has been progressively evaluating opportunities for improving operational viability of the various businesses of CG. The transformer market in Western Europe is facing both over capacity and price pressure. Therefore, in order to have globally competitive and sustainable business operations in Europe, it is proposed that CG's Belgium operations be optimised for cost advantages, through administrative cost reduction measures and a right-sizing of its blue collar and white collar workforce. Approximately 260 employees are contemplated to be covered under the right-sizing exercise, out of a total of approximately 730 employees. Towards the above, the Company has commenced an information and consultation process with the Belgian Works Council regarding overhead reduction and potential right-sizing of employees at its Belgium operations, as required by the Belgium Labor Regulations. The Company has adequately prepared itself to respond to the needs of business continuity during the possible rationalisation exercise."
